# HowStuffWorks Science

> HowStuffWorks Science explores the intersection of science, spirituality, mathematics, and natural phenomena through accessible educational content and myth-busting articles.

The site covers diverse topics ranging from rigorous mathematical and statistical education to spiritual interpretations of numerology, tarot, and chakras, alongside fascinating science articles about natural wonders and extreme environments. Content is written by expert contributors and illustrated with professional imagery.

## Key Topics

- Angel Numbers
- Tarot Interpretation
- Numerology
- Spiritual Guidance
- Manifestation
- Mathematical Concepts
- Data Analysis
- Statistics
- Twin Flame Connections
- Chakras
- Natural Phenomena
- Oceanography
- Thermodynamics
- Extreme Sports
- Measurement Systems

## Mathematics & Data Science

- [Mean, Median, Mode: 3 Different Measures of Central Tendency](https://science.howstuffworks.com/math-concepts/mean-median-mode.htm): Statistical education guide to central tendency measures.
- [8 Types of Data That Inform Insights and Relationships](https://science.howstuffworks.com/math-concepts/types-of-data.htm): Educational reference on data types for analysis and statistics.
- [Polygons: Regular vs. Irregular, Convex vs. Concave](https://science.howstuffworks.com/math-concepts/polygons.htm): Math education guide explaining polygon types and classifications.
- [Finding Factors of 36: Factor Trees and Prime Factorization](https://science.howstuffworks.com/math-concepts/factors-of-36.htm): Educational guide to finding factors and prime factorization of 36.
- [Tonnes vs. Tons: Metric vs. Imperial Measurements Strike Again](https://science.howstuffworks.com/tonnes-vs-tons.htm): Reference guide comparing metric tonnes and imperial tons.

- [The 808 Angel Number: A Sign of Luck, Manifestation, and Infinite Possibilities](https://science.howstuffworks.com/science-vs-myth/extrasensory-perceptions/808-angel-number.htm): Angel number 808 meaning for abundance and spiritual enlightenment.
- [Chakra Colors: The Key to Unlocking Your Spiritual Potential](https://science.howstuffworks.com/science-vs-myth/extrasensory-perceptions/chakra-colors.htm): Spiritual guide to chakra colors and energy alignment.

## Natural Science & Phenomena

- [What Color Is the Hottest Flame?](https://science.howstuffworks.com/what-color-is-the-hottest-flame.htm): Science of flame color and thermodynamics of combustion.
- [What Was the Largest Wave Ever Recorded?](https://science.howstuffworks.com/environmental/earth/oceanography/largest-wave-ever-recorded.htm): Oceanography article on Lituya Bay tsunami and rogue waves.
- ['Mad Honey' Comes From Bees That Gather This Specific Nectar](https://science.howstuffworks.com/innovation/edible-innovations/mad-honey.htm): Explore mad honey's neurotoxin properties and historical medicinal uses.

## Extreme Environments & Adventure

- [The Most Dangerous Mountain to Climb (and 14 Giving Steep Competition)](https://science.howstuffworks.com/environmental/earth/most-dangerous-mountain-to-climb.htm): Ranking of dangerous mountains including Annapurna and K2.
- [What's the Scariest Roller Coaster in the World? 10 Contenders](https://science.howstuffworks.com/engineering/structural/scariest-roller-coaster-in-the-world.htm): Ranked guide to world's scariest roller coasters and thrill rides.
